text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry.
I... couldn't win today either.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: ...Everyone around me keeps moving further and further ahead... while I...!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: I know that! I know I'm lacking in so many ways...!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Even so... I still have a place
I'm striving to reach!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
choice_data_list: Hold onto that feeling and you'll be just fine.
Let's start by discarding your weak self.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
choice_data_list: Keep going, and you'll definitely reach the top.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Right... We are still only halfway there.
...The pain is proof that we're moving forward.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Even if I have to struggle through it, I'll keep moving forward.
Believing that one day, I'll reach the summit...!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Ngh! Yes! I want to throw it away.
Because I want to become stronger.
choice_data_list: In that case, you can't just stare at their back.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
! ...You're right.
If I just keep chasing after their back, I'll never overtake them.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: The one who turns it into a dead end is always myself.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: I'm going to believe in myself more!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
"I can still go further, climb higher, keep on going!
I'll polish myself more and more—to win!"
